1. Choose a folder
   Tap "Recording Folder" above and pick any folder on your device.
   BobTV will save all recordings there.

2. Start recording
   While watching a channel, tap the record (●) button in the
   player controls. Recording starts immediately.

3. Stop recording
   Tap the record button again, or change channels.
   The file is saved as MP4 in your chosen folder.

4. View recordings
   Open "Recordings" in the sidebar to browse and play
   your saved recordings.

Tips:
• Make sure you have enough disk space
• Recordings use the original stream quality
• On macOS: the folder picker grants BobTV access automatically
• On Android: choose a folder in internal storage or SD card
